scope: Object-presence inspection only; object-category recognition is not validated

limitations: Three views per class/distance; empirical diagnostic, not a statistical guarantee.
No universal recognition radius was inferred when any class failed at 1 m.
Planar coverage describes analyzed views within the supported-class range; it is not all-object recognition.
Uniform lighting, synthetic assets, horizontal low camera; no real-world or small-object guarantee.
Distances below 1 m were not sampled; close-up clipping and continuous-distance performance remain unvalidated.
